difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that if some cohomology group of a smooth projective scheme is nonzero in a negative degree, then some equidimensional smooth projective scheme fails the equivalent characterizations of the degree zero cohomology (statement lines 3928-3934). The proof (proof lines 3935-3951) reduces to an even negative degree and multiplies by a power of the projective line to exhibit a direct summand of the degree zero cohomology outside the image of the comparison map. H3: a reduction with an explicit construction, written out in full.
